overview.title: Empower Your Kitchen & Business
overview.text:
Whether you want to upgrade your daily family meals or start a profitable home-based food delivery business, our intensive cooking course is the perfect starting point.

This course focuses on practical hands-on kitchen training. We cover knife skills, classic mother sauces, culinary hygiene, and menu planning. Culinary Academy ensures you build real confidence under professional executive chefs in a state-of-the-art training environment.

highlights.description: From daily home cooked favorites to gourmet restaurant appetizers.

highlights.title: 4 Weeks
highlights.description: Intensive weekend and weekday schedules (8 sessions).

highlights.title: Kitchen Costing
highlights.description: Learn recipe cost calculation to run a profitable food business.

faqs.question: Do I need any prior cooking experience to join?
faqs.answer: No. This course starts from basic knife handling and food preparation, making it perfect for absolute beginners.

faqs.question: Is this course suitable if I want to open a cloud kitchen?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes basic food costing, bulk prep tips, and hygiene standards that are essential for starting a commercial delivery kitchen.

faqs.question: Can I pay the course fee in installments?
faqs.answer: For short courses under BDT 15,000, we require full payment at admission, but credit card EMI options are available.
